description: This file defines configuration structures, callback prototypes, enums, and data types for the Dem (Diagnostic Event Manager) module in an AUTOSAR-based automotive software platform, Arctic Core. It includes references to external files, callback functions, and configuration data structures related to diagnostic events, freeze frames, DTCs, and related parameters.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackInitMonitorForEventFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for initializing monitor for an event, takes Dem_InitMonitorKindType parameter.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackInitMonitorForFunctionFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for initializing monitor for a function, no parameters.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackEventStatusChangedFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for handling event status changes, takes old and new status parameters.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackDTCStatusChangedFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for handling DTC status changes, takes old and new status bytes.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackConditionCheckReadFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for condition check read, varies based on USE_DCM macro.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackReadDataFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for reading data, varies based on USE_DCM macro.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackReadDataLength
methods.description: Function pointer type for reading data length, varies based on USE_DCM macro.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackGetExtDataRecordFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for getting extended data record.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackGetFaultDetectionCounterFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for getting fault detection counter.

methods.name: Dem_CallbackGetPIDValueFncType
methods.description: Function pointer type for getting PID value.
